input.content:
# Astronomy Interest on Ukrainian Wikipedia is Declining

Interest in astronomy on Ukrainian Wikipedia has declined 61.7% year over year, with high confidence. None of the last 12 months exceeded the same month from the prior year.

## Findings
- All 12 recent months underperformed their year-earlier equivalents, indicating a consistent, broad decline rather than a temporary dip.
- The astronomy article averages 559 views per month across both years, representing 9.69 per million views on the platform.
- Ukrainian Wikipedia's overall traffic fell 24.6% year over year, but astronomy declined more steeply (42.4 percentage points faster), signaling topic-specific loss of interest beyond platform-wide trends.
- The topic shows strong September seasonality (approximately 2.3× typical views), consistent with back-to-school patterns, but this annual peak has not offset the decline.

## Next steps
- Investigate whether the September peak correlates with the Ukrainian school calendar or academic events (e.g., astronomy olympiads).
- Compare astronomy interest across other major Wikipedia editions (Russian, Polish, English) to see whether this decline is regional or global.
- Check whether competing resources (astronomy social media, planetarium apps, or dedicated Ukrainian astronomy forums) have grown during this period.
